connects_to.relationship: strategic long-term supply agreement for indium phosphide substrates

contracts.signal: AXT-Tongmei entered a Master Development and Supply Agreement with Coherent Corp (signed June 26, 2026, effective June 25, 2026) for the mass development and supply of 6-inch indium phosphide wafer substrates for an initial term of three years. AXT agreed to increase manufacturing capacity for these products at its Beijing facility in 2026 through 2028 and committed an agreed product capacity to Coherent in exchange for a prepayment of US$22,288,500 from Coherent, applied to product purchases at agreed per-wafer prices; additional capacity beyond the committed quantity is to be offered to Coherent on the same terms.
contracts.type: master development and supply agreement (capacity commitment)
